name: Spire Ledger
author: MokoGuy (fork of Damage Charts by zaxnyd)
description: Co-op stats for Slay the Spire 2: your own stats under every card offered; each player's damage next to their name (Poison and Doom credited to whoever applied them); a forecast of the HP you're about to lose; an end-of-run recap with the numbers behind each player's badges; and a Ledger in the Compendium comparing you with each teammate and showing your win rates per character, relic and card over all your runs. The mod only observes: friends without it can still join.
